activity.notes: David Ben-Gurion headed Israel's provisional government from the establishment of the State of Israel on 14 May 1948 and continued as Prime Minister through the first four governments. This reviewed Activity is the seed for separating the modern State of Israel from the unrelated premonarchic ancient-Israel polity that currently shares the generic Israel identity.

sources.title: David Ben-Gurion — Knesset
sources.citation_text: The Knesset identifies Ben-Gurion as Israel's first Prime Minister and records his first premiership before his later return.

sources.title: Past Governments — Prime Minister's Office, Israel
sources.citation_text: The Israeli Prime Minister's Office records David Ben-Gurion as prime minister of the Provisional Government beginning 14 May 1948 and through the Fourth Government ending 26 January 1954.
